title: Paella cooking with Nicole
text: We did a market tour and paella cooking with Nicole in her Barcelona home and had a fantastic time!  She walked us through the streets near her home to shop in the market for the seafood we would use in the paella.  The cooking experience was great as we did it outside on her rooftop patio with a nice view of the surrounding neighborhood. I would highly recommend this experience with Nicole!
author: andrewbC3589DJ

title: Expanding my palette
text: Nicole was very informative with the ingredients and how to layer ingredients. It was a great learning experience and we have decided to do it again when we do it again. The dish was so rich with flavor and I can't wait to try to make it at home.
author: L5202PPaaronj

title: A Perfect Rooftop Paella Class in Barcelona!
text:
We spent an unforgettable day with Chef Nicole Hooks through Traveling Spoon, learning to make traditional paella and Crema Catalana on her sunny rooftop terrace overlooking Barcelona.

Nicole met us at a nearby café before leading us on a short walk through the Jardins de la Rambla de Sants, an elevated park full of murals and local life. At the Mercat de Sants, she shopped like a true local, explaining ingredients and sharing stories of the neighborhood. We loved the personal touches and storytelling along the way.

title: AMAZING Experience!
text: Cooking with Nicole will leave a lasting impression on my husband  Greg and me . Not only was our food amazing , but it was an incredible experience. We felt like we were at home hanging out with a friend . We can not wait to go home and cook our new dish for our family ! Highly recommend cooking with Nicole!
author: beckycD3717HG

title: Paella class was one of the highlights of our trip!
text:
This review is overdue!  My friend and I decided to book a paella cooking class with Nicole and it was by far one of the biggest highlights of the trip!  To start, Nicole’s flat and rooftop setup is the authentic setting we were looking for.  It was the perfect balance of a cooking classroom (you can tell Nicole was a former teacher and details like a map of Spain that Nicole referenced throughout was a great, unexpected value add to the cooking classroom) /entertaining environment.  

Nicole herself was a delight.  Not only was she a great instructor, but she is genuinely a kind, cool person
author: Global11374247042

title: A Fantastic cooking experience in Barcelona.
text:
Our visit with Nicole to learn how to cook Fideua was truly a joyful experience. Fideua is similar to paella but with short thin noodles instead of rice. Better tasting and considerably faster to make, what is not to love. 

Being invited into her home was special. We talked Barcelona, cooking, living in Spain, and educational differences while cooking, learning, eat, and drinking wine. Highly recommend it!
author: 834blairf

title: Learn cooking, be immersed in culture
text: Nicole is a wonderful cultural guide and culinary teacher. We so enjoyed going to the market with her, buying the ingredients for Paella and learning how to create each step. She is a great teacher and also someone able to share the experience of being an American overseas. It was a great afternoon! Highly reccomend.
author: Coastal732593

title: Amazing time with our family
text: We had an amazing time at our paella making class with our family. It was great to learn more about Barcelona and eat fantastic dishes. Highly recommend!!
author: annapH8969QW

title: Great Paella Experience
text:
Nicole was wonderful! She is so gracious and welcoming and had everything ready and nicely displayed for our cooking class. It was very fun  to go through all the steps of making Paella and getting to eat it at the end of the class. We made dessert too! It was also nice to be in her home and hearing some about life in Spain and experiencing a bit of it at the same time! 
Thank you so much!
author: pdurna

title: Family fun paella cooking class with local chef in Barcelona!
text: My family and I recently took a seafood paella cooking class with Nicole while on a trip to Barcelona in 2025, and cannot recommend it enough. Nicole invited us into her own home for the lesson, and it made the whole experience feel so personal. While we learned all about the dish and local culture surrounding it we enjoyed local snacks, wine, and good conversation.
